rules: 1. Doc: Resolves a former entity ref, as declared by an entity's backstage.io/former-names annotation, to the current ref of the entity that claims it. Remarks: resolves to undefined when the ref is the current ref of an entity, when no entity claims it, when several entities claim it, or when the caller may not read the claimant. The method is optional so that existing implementations keep compiling; callers check that it exists. @param formerRef - a complete former entity ref, on string or compound form; @param options - Additional options; @returns the current entity ref, or undefined.
